items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Rip Van Winkle' is a literary reference/joke within a conversation about a name, not a reference to a person named Van Winkle with whom Gil Evans has a personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: We were trying to figure out who Ichabod Crane was when you said that the other day and you said it and we were trying to figure it out.
First, we thought it was the one who slept twenty years. But that was Rip Van Winkle.
Rip Van Winkle (LAUGHTER). No, he was the old school teacher.
